3  Dictionary

This is a (Kadagidze and Kadagidze 1984) dictionary with some additions from Diana Kakashvili and Jesse Wichers Schreur. It still need some polishing. Download in .csv or .xslx format. Use the Extended version in order to see all fields, and don’t forget to scroll to the right in order to see some hidden columns.

  • Extended version
Kadagidze, Davit, and Niko Kadagidze. 1984. C’ova-Tušur-Kartul-Rusul Leksik’oni [Tsova-Tush-Georgian-Russian Dictionary]. Mecniereba.
